card.name: Inside brand and drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through a drug brand or generic name, on the piece just before the name ends, when the drug is the subject of a sentence in a label. Mostly capitalised brand names such as INGREZZA or Cleviprex.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: An inner piece of a multi-part brand name, often in capitals, before the name is complete.
modes.example: Avoid use of BIM<<Z>>ELX in patients with active IBD

modes.label: Generic name pieces
modes.description: An inner piece of a generic drug name before the name ends.

card.writes: It suggests the drug name is about to finish, and a verb such as contains or is located may follow.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a drug's name, before the name is finished.
